apple_promotional_text: Immersive chat with friends. Selected words in your messages switch into the language you are learning and back.
google_short_description: Immersive chat with friends. Learn a language through your everyday messages.
description_without_subscription_terms:
Chat with friends as usual. Selected words and short phrases switch in place into the language you are learning. Your friends do not need to change how they write.

Choose how many new words appear; previously seen words may appear too. Other wording, word order and grammar stay unchanged. Vocabulary varies by language. Try the English and Spanish example before signing in.

Pause switching, show the original or tap Listen. Latin-letter reading guides and voices depend on the language and downloads. Automatic switching runs on your device without a translation model download; full translation is a separate on-device action and may require one.

Connect by username and invitation. Chats with friends are end-to-end encrypted. Save an encrypted history backup to a location you choose.

vBot is a chatbot; Bot mini is an optional additional plan. Messages to vBot go to our response provider, and automated replies can be mistaken. The monthly reply allowance is shown before subscribing.

Privacy: https://api.mambovipi.app/privacy
Terms: https://api.mambovipi.app/terms
subscription_paragraph: Your first 30 days of Vipi are free, without starting a subscription or providing payment details. After that, choose whether to subscribe. There is no automatic charge when the free period ends. In the US, Vipi is $12 per year. Bot mini is a separate optional $48-per-year subscription and requires active Vipi access. Bot mini offers its own one-month free trial for eligible subscribers. Your store shows the local price and renewal date before purchase. Subscriptions you choose renew automatically unless canceled through your store. You can still read and export your existing local history after access ends.
